cases.name: foreign
cases.reason: Actual Node accepts an agent-private source tuple with another ownerUserId when agentId matches. Native destructive cleanup requires every present endpoint tuple to equal the original private user/agent/workspace binding and both actual rows; row/edge authority is never inferred from one matching field.

boundaries: Missing all serialized claims retains RE-D129 explicit native top-level and actual-row authorization. Partial/null/unbound/rebuild/duplicate claims do not bypass validation.
Frozen Node goldens and recall ACL behavior remain unchanged; this helper is specific to destructive private graph cleanup.
cost: Four small tuple comparisons per eligible edge, no extra provider or wire calls.
